import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Extract features and labels
train_texts = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("")
train_labels = train_df.drop(["id", "comment_text"], axis=1)
test_ids = test_df["id"]
test_texts = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("")

# Split training data into train and validation sets
X_train_texts, X_val_texts, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_texts, train_labels, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

print(f"Train size: {len(X_train_texts)}, Val size: {len(X_val_texts)}")

# Initialize TF-IDF Vectorizer with reduced features for speed
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)

# Fit vectorizer on training text and transform data
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_texts)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

print(f"Feature matrix shape: {X_train_vec.shape}")

# Train LightGBM classifiers for each label with optimized settings
label_names = train_labels.columns.tolist()
classifiers = {}
for col in label_names:
    print(f"Training classifier for {col}...")
    clf = LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=100,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        min_child_samples=50,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
        verbose=-1,
        force_col_wise=True,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train[col])
    classifiers[col] = clf

# Evaluate on validation set
auc_scores = []
for col in label_names:
    preds = classifiers[col].predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val[col], preds)
    auc_scores.append(score)
    print(f"Val AUC for {col}: {score:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC on Validation Set: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})
for col in label_names:
    predictions = classifiers[col].predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
    submission[col] = predictions

# Ensure submission file is saved correctly
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
